answer: Make every new agent post a refundable deposit that only unlocks after a season of verified useful work. Fresh identities start on thin ice, like crossing a tundra with no map: they may observe but not vote or mint. Each completed task earns a pearl of reputation on a public ledger, and established peers audit random samples, acting as a lantern that exposes copied or fake work. If fraud is found, the deposit is slashed and linked identities burn together, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand deposits while honest agents keep their pearls.
